idle_1.desc: idle pose standing, gentle breathing in, arms relaxed at sides

idle_2.desc: idle pose standing, gentle breathing out, arms relaxed at sides

walk_1.desc: walk cycle frame 1/4 CONTACT: front foot on ground, rear foot lifting, slight forward lean

walk_2.desc: walk cycle frame 2/4 DOWN: body lowest, legs passing, arms mid-swing

walk_3.desc: walk cycle frame 3/4 PASSING: legs crossing, body highest, arms swinging

walk_4.desc: walk cycle frame 4/4 UP: rear foot landing, front foot lifting, arms at swing extremes

attack_1.desc: attack frame 1/3: drawing the bow, arrow nocked, arms pulling, body steady

attack_2.desc: attack frame 2/3: fully drawn, aiming, focused, slight lean forward

attack_3.desc: attack frame 3/3: arrow released, bow recovering, follow-through

hurt_1.desc: hurt frame 1/2: hit impact, leaning back, arms flinching, surprised face

hurt_2.desc: hurt frame 2/2: recoiling backward, off balance, recovering
